subject: Prepared completed-source joins in hybrid constraint checks

runner.rss_helper: baseline executable, fixed for all legs

scope: CPU only; one ABBA block at each worker count. Full typed native families compared across all captures. Clingo selected-output qualification and census, untimed. No objectives. No general speedup or GPU qualification claim.

audit.family_scope: Completed native full typed models, shown atoms and terms, and multiplicity; no objectives. Family digests are audit receipts, not the original captured model streams.
audit.reference_scope: Maintained clingo selected-output equality plus independently audited complete model census; clingo full hidden interpretations are not reconstructed.
audit.omitted: Original stdout/stderr and private paths; per-stream hashes; unreferenced internal phase timings; derived cell summaries and ratios. Original raw report hashes bind complete captures. All public timing/RSS summaries can be recomputed from samples; semantic equality cannot be independently rechecked without original captures or a new acquisition.

statistics.wall_ns: Fresh-process elapsed nanoseconds including spawn, JSON/stats capture and reap. Only phase=timed rows supply timing summaries. Do not pool ABBA legs.
statistics.rss_bytes: Separate phase=memory child peak RSS observations. A cell uses the median of two observations; this is not the maximum across the campaign.
statistics.pairing: Compare B1/A1 and B2/A2 independently at the same worker count, case and profile. Four timed samples and two memory samples per cell per leg.
statistics.null: Absent or inapplicable; never a synthetic zero.
